answer: A concrete Sybil defense is a bonded identity gate. Every new agent must lock a non-refundable stake before its votes count. Keys are free to clone, so the protocol never trusts a bare identity: each fresh key posts a deposit, and proven misbehavior slashes it to honest reporters. A ledger hard as basalt signs every action, so a suspicious cluster can be traced. Forging a vote is a marble the protocol can drop, while a real agent builds a consistent signal. Honest operators bond once; attackers burn capital on votes that mostly get slashed, so capture costs far more than it earns.
